findings.text: Biggest gain: Start to T1, +0.34 s for LEC L36 over PER L40. Reaches 21 km/h higher top speed.
Gain #2: T13, +0.18 s for PER L40 over LEC L36. No clear difference in the recorded channels.
Gain #3: T4, +0.14 s for PER L40 over LEC L36. Gets on the throttle 21 m later.
Gain #4: T10-T11 straight, +0.12 s for LEC L36 over PER L40. Reaches 6 km/h higher top speed.
Gain #5: T8, +0.10 s for LEC L36 over PER L40. Brakes 21 m later, carries 2 km/h more minimum speed, gets on the throttle 16 m earlier.
